text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's the day before Spring Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All right, then... Decorating team,<n>follow me to the
next location!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have something better to<n>do? Like...
work? You shouldn't slack<n>off too much, you know.
choice_data_list: Ahaha... You sure are working hard, Dober.
You sure are working hard, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Did you come here to check on me?<n>Hehe...
Thanks.
choice_data_list: Ahaha... You sure are working hard, Dober.
You sure are working hard, Dober!

text_block_list.text: I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I asked the student council if I could<n>help out with
Fan Fest this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You know how Air Groove is such an<n>amazing
student council vice<n>president?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if I tried leading<n>something like this,
I'd be able to<n>figure out how to be more like her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ack, this is no time to be chatting! I<n>have to get back
to work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! I have to get going! There's<n>so much left
to do. The student<n>council sure is busy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to be slacking off<n>anyway, you
might as well come and<n>see things on the day of!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
See you later, Trainer. I'll be sure to<n>make some
time for you on the day<n>of!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I watch Mejiro Dober lead the<n>younger students
off, looking every<n>bit like the Empress herself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I watch Mejiro Dober lead the<n>younger students
off, looking every<n>bit like the Empress herself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why, I can hardly believe one student<n>is doing so
much! Mejiro Dober is<n>proving herself an
industrious worker.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However... Hm. You do not look too<n>pleased.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry to cause you concern. I never<n>can hide
anything from you, can I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's nothing I can say to<n>sway Mejiro
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I understand.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, it's finally time for the<n>Spring Fan
Fest.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So yeah! Dober's gone and gotten<n>herself a fever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that we're on the same<n>page, let's
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm no match for an Umamusume,<n>especially one
as strong as Taiki<n>Shuttle, so resistance is futile.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle hoists me over her<n>shoulder and
carries me off to...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dober! The Taiki Visitation<n>Express has
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know you're trying to be quiet, but<n>you're still
really loud. My head hurts,<n>so could you please...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Taiki, did you drag my trainer here?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Drag? Of course not! The Taiki<n>Express treats its
passengers to a<n>firefighter's carry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's the same thing! U-urgh... My<n>head...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's with the ruckus in here?<n>Dober's
supposed to be restin' right<n>now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
O-oh no! Hishiama's here! Trainers<n>aren't allowed
in the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problemo! Just leave this to me,<n>Dober! I've got
a plan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, partner! Well...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm off to do somethin' dangerous<n>and real terrible!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What?! What're you talking about?!<n>Taikiiiii! Get
back here!

Because of Taiki Shuttle's quick and<n>clever (?)
thinking, I avoid getting<n>caught.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... the student council duties<n>were more
intense than I thought.
choice_data_list: Did you push yourself too hard?
Did you push yourself too hard?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes... Stupid, I know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've still got a long way to go before I<n>can be like
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, forget about that. Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm just reaping what I sowed, so<n>you don't have
to stay. Go and<n>enjoy the Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm just reaping what I sowed, so<n>you don't have
to stay with me. You<n>should go back and enjoy the
Fan<n>Fest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her words, the look on<n>her face
suggests she'd rather have<n>company as she fights
off this fever.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her words, the look on<n>her face
suggests she'd rather have<n>company as she fights
off this fever.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm not allowed in the dorm, I<n>really shouldn't
stay long, but I can't<n>just leave her like this.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do for you?
Is there anything I can do for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? You'd... do me a favor?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, wait! ...Ugh, what's gotten into<n>me? Must be the
fever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Can I really ask you for something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: O-okay, then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That apple over there... Could you<n>peel it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Could you, um... put your hand on my<n>forehead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Have I ever told you? I, um... I like<n>fruit, so...

When I was little, Ryan would do that<n>for me
whenever I had a fever, and...<n>it helped me sleep
better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Please?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Please?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, while listening to the hustle<n>and bustle of
Fan Fest in the<n>distance, I peel an apple for Mejiro
Dober...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, while listening to the hustle<n>and bustle of
Fan Fest in the<n>distance, I rest my hand on Mejiro
Dober's forehead...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What is this, a monster? Wait, is it<n>supposed to be a
rabbit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Your hand...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the best you could do?<n>Haha, pretty
sad... Mm, it tastes good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's so... warm.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's not for long, but Mejiro Dober<n>and I spend
some quality time<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The next morning...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I stay with Mejiro Dober until she<n>falls asleep, then
leave the dorm<n>quietly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Did you sleep well? I brought you a<n>present!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A present? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! It's all the fan letters you got<n>at Fan Fest!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So many kind words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! They're all rooting for you,<n>Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(They're not just about my races.<n>People are
saying they feel<n>encouraged by my words and
attitude... I don't really get it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now you have no choice but to<n>get better
fast, hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The next morning...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober! How's your fever?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove! I'm all better now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm sorry about yesterday! I<n>said I would help,
then ended up<n>being useless on the day of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I'm all ready to go again! I'm<n>going to do my
best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My best to become more like you,<n>that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're in your senior year already.<n>We're both
fighting for victory on the<n>same stage now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So I want you to listen to me very<n>carefully.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
These are my last words for you as<n>one who walks
before you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober. As you are right now,<n>the future and
glory you crave are far<n>beyond your reach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because those are things that only<n>one person in
the world can ever<n>claim.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And that person is Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I told you those were my last words<n>for you. You'll
need to figure out the<n>rest on your own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-wait! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Dober. I'm proud of you, my<n>beloved successor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But role models are meant to be<n>surpassed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One day, you will part the clouds with<n>your own
hand and become a shining<n>light yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will wait patiently for that moment.
